headline: NUPRC seeks UNIBEN partnership to boost oil production
summary: The Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission (NUPRC) has offered to partner with UNIBEN on gas and heavy oil research. The move supports Nigeria's target of three million barrels of crude oil per day by 2030.
why: Nigeria is Africa's largest oil producer, and its output targets shape government revenue, foreign-exchange inflows and investment in its upstream sector.
